desc: Implement input parsing and binary search over answer D in [0, min(K, N-1)].

Implement feasibility check `can(D)`: layered flow network with per-edge gadget node (capacity-1 bottleneck shared across layers), cross-layer INF arcs, source (1,0), super-sink from (N,d) for d<D; feasible iff max-flow ≤ K.
Edge cases: multi-edges get separate gadgets (sample 3 → 0); infeasible D yields flow = INF > K.
Final solve() with stdin/stdout in required format.
